technical.title: MonoMIP adds multi-height inverse perspective mapping for monocular 3D object detection.
technical.summary: MonoMIP is a dual-decoder framework that constructs Bird's-Eye View features via Multi-Height Inverse Perspective Mapping at multiple elevation planes to reduce misprojection and handle spatial distortion.
technical.why: It improves 3D geometric reasoning in monocular vision models for autonomous systems.

technical.title: End-to-end vision-language-action policies proposed for autonomous lunar rover docking.
technical.summary: End-to-end learned policies map lunar surface observations directly to control actions to bypass measurement error propagation in hand-engineered modular navigation pipelines.
technical.why: It showcases the application of vision-language-action models to planetary rover navigation.

technical.title: Researchers introduce CLASHarness to benchmark multi-agent conflicts in computer-use workflows.
technical.summary: CLASHarness evaluates vision-language models in multi-agent computer-use systems by generating verifiable environments where sub-agents face conflicts, outdated states, and competing permissions.
technical.why: It provides a scalable way to evaluate VLM agents handling real-world collaborative conflicts.

technical.title: Survey examines data-centric approaches for spatial reasoning in multimodal large language models.
technical.summary: A comprehensive survey reviews fine-tuning techniques, dataset construction, data modality, and evaluation methods for improving spatial reasoning in multimodal large language models used in robotics.
technical.why: It offers valuable data-centric design principles for improving MLLM spatial capabilities.

technical.title: VideoHarness-BRSI introduces recursive self-improvement for agentic video understanding.
technical.summary: Researchers study recursive harness evolution for agentic video understanding, introducing a framework that evolves execution harnesses around a frozen vision-language model using limited feedback.
technical.why: It demonstrates how to automate the design of complex multimodal agent execution harnesses.

technical.title: Meta launches Muse Spark Open, an 816B mixture-of-experts model.
technical.summary: Meta introduces Muse Spark Open, a coding-optimized 816B MoE model with 42B active parameters and a 1M token context window, hosted on NVIDIA infrastructure.
technical.why: It gives engineers a massive new open-weight frontier model for advanced coding workflows.

technical.title: Third Moment Research scales 10,000 agents for multi-day operations.
technical.summary: An AI lab utilizes advanced GPT-6 models, Codex, and specialized cybersecurity tools to build and run agents that maintain focus for over 36 hours and self-improve.
technical.why: It offers insight into the infrastructure and reliability scaling required for long-horizon agents.

technical.title: WEDGE framework uses navigation agent failure modes to guide environment generation.
technical.summary: WEDGE uses an LLM to propose executable weakness features from contrasting successful and failed attempts, generating targeted training environments for pretrained navigation agents.
technical.why: It directly connects simulated environment generation to specific embodied agent failure modes.

technical.title: Defining strategic selection as a meta game layered on top of LLM base games.
technical.summary: Researchers extend game-theoretic evaluations by defining strategic selection as a meta-game, deploying an LLM portfolio selector to handle unknown, adaptive opponents under quality-cost trade-offs.
technical.why: It addresses how to select LLMs for strategic multi-agent interactions against adaptive opponents.

technical.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL empowers specialized agents with advanced multimodal reasoning.
technical.summary: NVIDIA launches Nemotron 3.5 Super VL to support always-on agents tackling complex, multi-source enterprise workflows.
technical.why: It provides new multimodal capabilities for enterprise agentic workflows.

business.title: Meta and Apple team up to run Muse AI models on Macs
business.summary: Meta announced the Muse Spark Open AI model and partnered with Apple to allow the model to run on desktop hardware using two Apple M5 Ultra Mac Studios and the MLX framework.
business.why: It highlights strategic hardware-software optimization for open-weight models on consumer workstation setups.

business.title: Tech giants race to deploy specialized engineering teams for AI returns
business.summary: AWS, Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google are racing to build forward-deployed engineering teams to help companies prove returns on their AI investments.
business.why: It shows how major AI players are restructuring technical deployment to secure enterprise confidence.

business.title: Anthropic reports third-quarter revenue hits $16.8 billion ahead of IPO
business.summary: Anthropic has reported a third-quarter revenue of $16.8 billion as it prepares for an upcoming initial public offering.
business.why: It gives you insight into the massive revenue scale of a leading AI lab ahead of going public.

business.summary: Day 2 at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, full of all themes across AI, as well as an investor-only session, more roundtables, Side Events, and more. Register to save 50% on your pass.

business.title: FTC probes Anthropic and OpenAI following political shifts
business.summary: The FTC may fine AI firms on par with companies that delay data breach reports, initiating a probe into Anthropic and OpenAI.
business.why: It highlights regulatory risks and potential compliance costs facing major foundational model providers.

business.title: Berkshire Hathaway makes $330 million investment in Bending Spoons
business.summary: Berkshire Hathaway invested $330 million in Bending Spoons, following its prior $600 million investment made during the company's July IPO.
business.why: It highlights major conglomerate backing in software and tech ecosystem companies.

business.title: AI marketing startup Marklo raises $5 million seed funding round
business.summary: Stella & Dot founder Jessica Herrin raised $5 million in a seed funding round led by Forerunner to launch Marklo AI, solving marketing challenges.
business.why: It tracks early-stage capital deployment into niche generative AI marketing tools.

models.title: Google DeepMind Releases Open Multimodal Embedding Model EmbeddingGemma 2
models.summary: EmbeddingGemma 2 is an open multimodal embedding model mapping text, code, images, video, and audio into a unified 768-dimensional vector space. With 740M total parameters, it runs on consumer hardware for on-device applications.
models.why: It provides low-latency multimodal semantic representations for on-device computer vision tasks like retrieval and classification.

models.title: Qwen Releases Accelerated Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo for Text-to-Image Generation
models.summary: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo is an accelerated checkpoint requiring only 8 denoising steps for text-to-image generation and editing. It uses a 7B visual generation architecture, CFG=1 by default, and prefix KV caching.
models.why: It accelerates visual generation pipelines with efficient 8-step denoising directly inside the Diffusers framework.

models.title: OpenBMB Introduces MiniCPM-V 4.7 as First MoE Vision Model
models.summary: MiniCPM-V 4.7 is a 35B-A3B Mixture of Experts vision model featuring single-image, multi-image, and video understanding capabilities. It introduces the Lookahead Expert Scheduling technique for lossless, smooth on-device inference.
models.why: It delivers advanced multi-image and video understanding for efficient on-device computer vision applications.

models.title: ConwayResearch Releases Underdog Saluki 27B 1.0 Quantized Model
models.summary: Underdog Saluki 27B 1.0 packs Qwen3.8-27B into under 8 GB using GGUF format while maintaining tool-calling capabilities. It also supports an optional vision add-on for processing images through the OpenAI chat API.
models.why: It enables lightweight local deployment of a large vision-language model with tool-calling support.

models.title: Baidu Releases Unlimited-OCR for Long-Horizon Parsing
models.summary: Unlimited-OCR is a model supporting one-shot long-horizon parsing. It integrates with ms-swift for training, vLLM for inference, and is available on Baidu Cloud, ModelScope, and Hugging Face Spaces.
models.why: It advances document parsing and text extraction capabilities for complex computer vision workflows.

models.title: Abenzerps Releases Uncensored Quantized Formats for Qwen-Image-2.1
models.summary: This release provides GGUF, Safetensors, and MLX quantized formats of Qwen-Image-2.1 for local image generation. It includes GGUF transformer, text encoder, and VAE companion files optimized for ComfyUI and Apple Silicon.
models.why: It allows engineers to run local, quantized versions of advanced image generation models on consumer hardware.
